heading: The Main Features Of Our Car Wash App Development Services

items.title: Customer Profile
items.text: Customers create a profile with contact details, saved vehicles and addresses.

items.title: Book Now
items.text: Request an immediate wash at the customer’s current location.

items.title: Schedule a Wash
items.text: Pick a convenient date and time slot for a later appointment.

items.title: Vehicle & Package
items.text: Choose the vehicle type and a wash package that fits the need.

items.title: Washer Tracking
items.text: Follow the washer on the map as they travel to the booking.

items.title: Live ETA
items.text: See an accurate arrival time for every confirmed booking.

items.title: Price Estimates
items.text: Show the cost up front based on vehicle type and selected services.

items.title: Multiple Payment Options
items.text: Pay with cash, cards or an in-app wallet.

items.title: Notification Alerts
items.text: Updates for confirmation, arrival, completion and offers.

items.title: Ratings & Reviews
items.text: Rate each wash and read feedback before choosing a provider.

items.title: Promo Codes
items.text: Discounts and loyalty offers that bring customers back.

items.title: Booking History
items.text: Review past washes and rebook with one tap.

items.title: Saved Locations
items.text: Store home and work addresses for faster booking.

items.title: Cancel or Reschedule
items.text: Change or cancel a booking within the allowed window.

items.title: Help & Support
items.text: Reach support directly from the app.

items.title: Invite Friends
items.text: Referral rewards for every friend who books.

items.title: Easy Registration
items.text: Washers sign up and submit documents for verification.

items.title: Set Availability
items.text: Go online or offline and choose working hours.

items.title: Live Job Requests
items.text: Receive nearby wash requests in real time.

items.title: Accept or Reject
items.text: Take the jobs that suit the schedule.

items.title: Job Details
items.text: See vehicle, package, address and notes before accepting.

items.title: Navigation
items.text: Turn-by-turn directions to the customer’s location.

items.title: Start & End Job
items.text: Mark a job as started and completed from the app.

items.title: Job Summary
items.text: A clear breakdown of services and amount for every job.

items.title: Track Earnings
items.text: Daily, weekly and monthly earnings at a glance.

items.title: Washer Dashboard
items.text: Jobs, ratings and earnings in one place.

items.title: Contact Customer
items.text: Call or message the customer without sharing numbers.

items.title: Upcoming Jobs
items.text: Plan the day with a list of scheduled washes.

items.title: Rate Customer
items.text: Leave feedback after each completed job.

items.title: Payment Management
items.text: Manage payouts and cash collections.

items.title: Job History
items.text: Browse every completed wash.

items.title: Support
items.text: Get help from the admin team when needed.

items.title: Secure Login
items.text: Role-based access for admins and managers.

items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.text: Bookings, revenue and activity summarised in real time.

items.title: Track Washers
items.text: Watch washers on a live map.

items.title: Manage Washers
items.text: Approve, suspend and review washer accounts.

items.title: Manage Customers
items.text: View and manage customer profiles and bookings.

items.title: Manage Services
items.text: Create wash packages, add-ons and categories.

items.title: Manage Pricing
items.text: Set prices by vehicle type, service and area.

items.title: Reports & Analytics
items.text: Understand peak hours, popular packages and revenue.

items.title: Manual Bookings
items.text: Create bookings for customers who call in.

items.title: Demand Heat Map
items.text: See where demand is highest and deploy washers.

items.title: Manage Refunds
items.text: Review and process refunds after verification.

items.title: SMS Alerts
items.text: Control which SMS alerts are sent and when.

items.title: Scheduling Settings
items.text: Define how far ahead customers can book.

items.title: Currency & Language
items.text: Multi-currency and multilingual support.

items.title: Push Notifications
items.text: Send offers and updates from the admin panel.

items.title: Payment Integration
items.text: Connect card, bank and wallet gateways.
